json.title: API returns 429 when rate limit is exceeded
json.body:
Calling `/v1/items` more than ~60 times per minute returns HTTP 429 with no
`Retry-After` header, so clients cannot back off correctly.

Expected: a `Retry-After` header on every 429 response.
Seeing this too on v2.3 when running the nightly sync job.
